section_summary.extract_value: This Introduction outlines the need to study positive body image and describes the present study's aim to translate and validate a German version of the Body Appreciation Scale (BAS). It specifies that the validation will be conducted with male and female community samples and to extend prior work limited to college students and primarily female samples.
section_summary.evidence_source: In short, the aim of the present study was to conduct a translation and validation of a German version of the BAS with male and female community samples. First, it would be beneficial to examine the psychometric properties of the BAS in internationally diverse populations, which the present study sought to achieve trough the development of a German translation of the BAS. Finally, given that Avalos et al. only examined college students, an additional purpose for the present study was to examine positive body image among a community sample.
